newsitem.title: USA: Calif. Diablo Canyon 2 nuke plant fully restored.
newsitem.headline: Calif. Diablo Canyon 2 nuke plant fully restored.

text.p: Pacfic Gas and Electric Co's 1,073 megawatt (MW) Diablo Canyon 2 nuclear power plant has resumed power production, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Friday.
Diablo Canyon 2 was manually shut down July 2 to correct problems with its feedwater system and has been gradually ramping up power production throughout this past week.
The Diablo Canyon facility, fully owned and operated by San Francisco-based PG&E, is at Avila Beach on the central California coast.
The facility's other unit, number 1, was running at its full 1,083 MW capacity, the NRC said in its daily plant status report.
